en: A monochrome postcard view of a small town in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground and mid‑ground are several two‑ to three‑story houses along a road, surrounded by trees and gardens. In the background, terraced fields rise up the hillsides. A prominent church or castle-like building with a tower stands on a wooded hill to the left, while another church spire is visible on the right. At the top of the image there is printed German text identifying the place and street.
